title: Orientation, exchange statistics, and rigidity in the Golden six-mode conference interferometer
description: This preprint identifies what a one-particle transfer retains under unframed, oriented, and phase-calibrated port descriptions. It proves that balanced exchange spectra of symmetric conference matrices are normalized cross-Gram spectra and are cut-independent only through half-size three, making the Golden six-mode case the unique nontrivial realized uniform example. Exact bosonic and fermionic benchmarks, calibrated Joubert sign coding, and a quantitative photonic design boundary accompany the theorem.
